name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-org-chart
title: Org Chart
shortDescription: An interactive org chart web part - drill through the reporting line, start from anyone, expand reports inline, full-screen explorer, and optional live Teams presence. No admin consent by default.
longDescription: A modern SharePoint org chart web part that reads the reporting line from the user profile service (PeopleManager), so it needs no admin consent. Click any person to re-root the chart, follow a breadcrumb back, and expand a person's team inline (lazy loaded). Start from the signed-in user or pick anyone with a type-ahead people picker. Each card can email, Teams-chat or Teams-call the person and open their profile. A full-screen explorer adds search, zoom and print / save-as-PDF. An optional toggle shows live Teams presence dots via Microsoft Graph (Presence.Read.All, User.ReadBasic.All) - off by default.
